Fretting chords without looking. Being able to fret without looking at the neck makes chord changes faster.
Do you look at your left hand every time you fret a chord?

When you play while looking at the chord chart for a song, your eyes get busy. Looking at the sheet music, looking at your left hand, and looking back at the sheet music. This movement can be the cause of delays in chord changes.
Today, I will introduce a practice method for fretting chords without looking at the neck.
1. Why practicing without looking is effective
When you fret while checking with your eyes, you memorize the finger positions with your "eyes".

When you practice fretting without looking, you memorize the finger positions with your "hand's sense." Chords memorized by your hand's sense can be fretted naturally even while looking at the sheet music.
